ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low ratio; visible pixels are approximately 97% low-intensity (black) and 3% high-intensity (white micro-spots and distal tip clusters).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous solid black field across both lobes; isolated white punctate spots localized in the lower medial regions; high-contrast brownish-white pixel clusters localized at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow U-shaped median notch with a pixel angle of approximately 25 degrees; notch depth occupies approximately 12% of the vertical fluke profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency, moderate-amplitude serrations; a distinct V-shaped indentation is visible on the left lobe's trailing edge approximately 40% from the median notch; distal tips exhibit high-frequency irregular topography due to biological encrustation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward convexity along the trailing edge curves, terminating in acute, upward-pointing distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of irregular circular pixel groups (barnacle colonization) localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes; scattered white circular micro-spots observed in the central-ventral region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent biological encrustation (barnacles) on the distal margins of both lobes, creating an irregular, textured boundary.
